title: Last server joined (<game>/kiln/state/last-server.json), format 1
description: Written atomically by Kiln.Network on a client when a server answers its join with REJECT or WELCOME (handshake properties: server id/name, modpack, required[]). The launcher watches this file to offer a modpack (consent modal; nothing auto-downloads). 'history' keeps up to 20 earlier entries, newest first, without their own history.

outcome.description: vanilla: the server sent no Kiln properties (not a Kiln server, or an old one).

truncated.description: required[] was cut to keep the frame <= 7 KB.

missing.description: On a refusal: the mods the REJECT names (what the server refused for). From the hosted world (hosted): none. Otherwise: required ids this game lacks or has with another hash, of every kind (Kiln and native mods, and other engines' mods in the game folder, compared by the hash the server advertises).

hosted.description: The server is this game's own world (a player hosting it: the server runs in this game and advertised this game's server id). Nothing it advertises can be missing then; the launcher offers no modpack for it. Written by Kiln after 0.2.0-dev.31.17 (absent before: false).
